answer: Simultaneous Physical Beacon Binding: each identity must, at dawn, transmit a signed timestamp from a hardware beacon bound to a fixed geographic ridge location. Beacons are sealed, tamper-evident, and registered to a verified installer; the comet-like pass of a satellite cross-checks timing. One operator cannot fake distinct beacons at separate ridges without physically deploying and powering each unit, so every extra identity costs hardware, installation, and site maintenance.
